newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen's Shum Yip Holdings sets US$60 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen's Shum Yip Holdings sets US$60 mln loan.

text.p: The following syndicated loan issue was announced by the coordinating arrangers.
BORROWER SHUM YIP HOLDINGS COMPANY LTD
AMOUNT US$60 MLN TYPE TERM LOAN AVG LIFE 2.375 YRS
MARGIN L+100BP MATURITY 3 YRS (EXTENDIBLE)**
PUTS -- CALLS -- LAUNCHED 26.MAY.97
DRAWDOWN -- AVAIL 6 MTHS HOME CTRY CHINA
REPAYMENT 5 SEMI-ANNUAL INSTALMENTS AFTER 1 YEAR'S GRACE***
REPLIES 16.JUN.97
COORDINATING ARRANGERS AND BOOKRUNNERS
COMMERZ (EAST ASIA) LTD (NON-ASIAN BOOKS) AND SUMITOMO BANK
(ASIAN BOOKS)
MGT LEVELS AND FEES
EXTENSION FEE OF 1 PCT FLAT
COMMITMENT FEE OF 0.375 PCT
ARRANGERS US$10 MLN+ 110BP ALL-IN 146.3
CO-ARRANGERS US$7 MLN 100BP ALL-IN 142.1
LEAD MANAGERS US$5 MLN 95BP ALL-IN 140.0
MANAGERS US$3 MLN 90BP ALL-IN 137.8
NOTES THE BORROWER IS THE OFFICIAL WINDOW CO OF THE SHENZHEN
MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENT. IT IS ALSO THE PARENT OF
HK-LISTED SHUM YIP INVESTMENT LTD
**THE FACILITY CAN BE EXTENDED FOR ANOTHER TWO YEARS AT
THE LENDERS' OPTION
***IF THE FACILITY IS EXTENDED, THE 5TH INSTALMENT SHALL
BE REPAID BY FOUR EQUAL SEMI-ANNUAL INSTALMENTS.
PROCEEDS WILL BE USED TO FINANCE THE ACQUISITIONS OF
INVESTMENT PROJECTS, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO AN
INTEREST IN SHENZHEN CNEDC-CONIC GLASS CO LTD AND
SHENZHEN CABLE BROADCASTING PROJECT, AND FOR GENERAL
WORKING CAPITAL.
SHENZHEN MUNICIPAL GOV'T WILL CONTINUOUSLY MAINTAIN
NOT LESS THAN 51 PCT OF THE BORROWER'S SHARES
-- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6960
